name: Failover Guard
description: Disables a channel and notifies a configured webhook target after repeated request.failover events.

threshold.title: Threshold
threshold.description: Failovers for the same channel and model inside the window before this plugin acts. The action runs once, when the count equals this number.

windowSeconds.title: Window seconds
windowSeconds.description: Counter window. The host accepts 1 to 86400 seconds.

target.title: Webhook target
target.description: Name of an existing webhook target. Empty skips the notification and still disables the channel.
